target_customer: Facilities managers at large buildings such as school districts, with data centers as the next target
problem: Buildings waste energy through unnoticed equipment faults and slow maintenance. Edviro connects to controls, meters and CMMS, drafts work orders for approval and verifies savings.
product_category: AI facilities management and energy optimization software

founders.name: Hursh Shah
previous_startups: Skyglass, smart glasses startup accepted to PearX
founders.background_notes: YC page mentions NeurIPS 2024, ChatGPT Lab and patent-pending medtech research.

founders.name: Tanuj Siripurapu
previous_startups: Digital presence agency scaled to $20K revenue in high school

competitors.name: BrainBox AI
competitors.what: AI HVAC optimization, acquired by Trane at the start of 2025

competitors.name: aedifion
competitors.what: German HVAC optimization startup reporting 86 percent revenue growth in 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrations with building controls, meters and CMMS are laborious, and forecasting and verification are standard ML.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with building systems create some stickiness, but well funded incumbents and acquired startups occupy the space.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Trane bought BrainBox AI in early 2025; outcome for Edviro is unknown.

market_need_then: A Schneider Electric study published for Climate Week NYC 2026 reports AI building management cut HVAC energy 15 to 27 percent (vendor study). YC launch post reports 34 facilities live and over $400K avoidable cost identified.

branding.domain_note: Moved from edviroenergy.com to edviro.com (301 redirect observed).

identity.logo: SVG logo; hero graphics use green gradients per page
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and outcome focused: Put your facility on autopilot, No alarms, just fixes

brand_strength.rationale: Name echoes environment and Enviro Power in searches; only a YC launch post and aggregator profiles exist.

outcome_analysis: Edviro is an Active Summer 2026 company with no outcome yet. Teenage founders report traction at 34 facilities, later site copy says 134 sites, and a move toward data centers. The category has a recent acquisition (BrainBox by Trane) and large controls incumbents.
notes: Unverified: Dealroom shows a $125k seed with hidden investors, so no round recorded. Site says 134 sites and $500K savings while YC page says 34 facilities and $400K, probably different dates. Founder education not found. Founded year not found.
